notes.content: It includes a game engine update: https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/730170/view/3639508126297589532

notes.title: Engine Update on Beta Branch
notes.content:
The 'beta' branch now has a version of Rocketboarder that uses a different engine version. I believe gameplay should be basically the same for most people. There are some changes besides the engine upgrade, for example some collision changes, some changes to movement logic, some different controller binding stuff, but I don't think most people would notice.

If you try it and find something that doesn't work in the beta branch that does work on the release branch, feel free to let me know.
